query: answer(s1_a_1_i_pos, Result) :-     fact(s1_a_1_i_pos, gross_income(alice, 2015, GI)),     s1_a_1_i_tax_imposed(s1_a_1_i_pos, alice, 2015, GI, TaxImposed),     TaxImposed > 0,     Result = true.

answer(s151_d_3_B_neg, Result) :-     fact(s151_d_3_B_neg, adjusted_gross_income(alice, 2015, AGI)),     s151_d_3_B_applicable_percentage(s151_d_3_B_neg, alice, 2015, AGI, ComputedPercentage),     ( round(ComputedPercentage) =\= 22 -> Result = true ; Result = false ).

answer(s2_b_1_A_i_II_pos, Result) :-     fact(s2_b_1_A_i_II_pos, gross_income(alice, 2019, GrossIncome)),     s2_b_1_A_i_II_applicable_percentage(s2_b_1_A_i_II_pos, alice, 2019, GrossIncome, ComputedPercentage),     (ComputedPercentage > 0 -> Result = true; Result = false).
